messages.subject: Notes: product meeting, Thursday 2 April
messages.body:
Liebe Alle,

Notes: v3 product meeting, Thursday 2 April, 10:00-11:00, meeting room Rotterdam.

Attendees: Marta, Dev, Priya, Jonas, Tomás, Aisha, Lena (notes)

Discussed:
- Bug burn-down: 41 open P1s as of Monday, tracking down but slowly
- Launch target: week of 11 May stands
- Scope: offline mode sizing presented (approx. 6 engineer-weeks full offline, including local edit queuing and conflict resolution)
- Alternative considered: cutting route optimization v2 instead - rejected, it is nearly done and already demoed to customers

Agreed: offline mode is cut from v3 and will ship in v3.1. Route optimization v2 stays in v3. Priya owns updating the roadmap.

Actions:
- Priya: update roadmap and inform sales/support - by Monday 6 April
- Jonas: park the offline branch, keep it rebase-ready for v3.1
- Dev: fold the freed capacity into the P1 burn-down plan
- Lena: circulate these notes

Danke,
Lena

Lena Fischer
Operations & Office Manager, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Notes: product meeting, Thursday 2 April
messages.body:
Hola Lena,

Thanks for the notes! One heads-up before I brief the pipeline: if a prospect asks about offline driving (a couple of the Spanish couriers have), what do I say - v3.1, or should I route it to Priya? I don't want to promise a date for v3.1 before we have one 🚀

Saludos,
Tomás

messages.subject: RE: Notes: product meeting, Thursday 2 April
messages.body: Good question - say "planned after launch" and no dates; I'll own the v3.1 window once the P1 burn-down clears. If a real deal hangs on it, loop me in before promising anything. Thanks!
